description: Session close for 16/09/2026 and handoff to the next AI. Records what was actually produced (10 role folders with documentation in Drive, 0 submissions), the two standing rules Dario set on 16/09, and releases the DARIO queue lane so the next AI can claim it. IMPORTANT ORDERING NOTE: batches 001, 002 and 003 were never applied - this session has no way to write cells, so every ops file to date is still pending. The found.patch ops below carry expect:{'Fit score':''}. If batch 002 is applied first those ops will REFUSE because the cell is no longer empty; that refusal is correct and harmless, and the receipt will name it. If 002 is never applied, these ops land the eight scores that matter for the current batch on their own. Found positions column Y (Actions) is protected and is deliberately not written anywhere in this file, so the per-role instructions live in ACTIVITY LOG and in the Drive folders instead.

ops.why: All four named channels (Google, Microsoft, Meta, LinkedIn) plus tracking, CRM reporting and AI optimisation are in the verified record, and the AI/automation half is unusually strong rather than merely adequate. Held below 90 because the posting asks for 2+ years, which is a mid-level band with undisclosed pay, and because the apply form requires the CV as a hosted URL that does not exist yet.

Paid media plus Ads Scripts plus AI automation and QA is the narrow intersection where the record is differentiated rather than merely qualified. Independent Contractor matches the Adaxa B2B route exactly and EMEA hours are native. Documentation prepared 16/09 in Drive folder '02 - OnTheGoSystems'.

Value is as a bridge rather than a replacement role: 20-25 h/week on contract during the LHG wind-down is income that does not block a full-time search. Paid-media requirement is covered; the pure-B2B requirement is not the record's depth. Documentation prepared 16/09 in Drive folder '08 - UTTR'.

Lowered from AI-1's 92 on two grounds read from the recorded requirements: 3+ years B2B including 1 year SaaS, where the case-study source puts the verified depth in ecommerce, retail and sensitive-category work; and a posted board salary of $75-85k, below the EUR 95-115k reference. Budget is not the constraint - the posting asks $50k/month against a record roughly 50x that.

Score reflects the role's CONTENT, which is a bullseye - Search, Shopping, PMax and Bing with feeds. It does not reflect viability: see the Priority change in the next op. Fit score and submittability are separate facts and are recorded separately.

cells.Priority: HOLD - employer unverified 16/09 (original posting not found; aggregator only) + live-screenshare NDA conflict + per-account pay, not salary

ops.why: Factual correction, not a preference. The Availability status column already records 'original not found; manual verify'. Per the project's own rule an aggregator is a discovery source only, so there is no verified employer and no verified apply route, which makes 'A - Strong' wrong on its face. Two further blockers survive even if the employer checks out: the posting requests a live results screenshare, which conflicts directly with client NDAs, and the pay is $500-1k per account plus variable rather than a salary, so the quoted $2-7k/month is volume-dependent. Drive folder '10 - Yoru' deliberately contains NO cover letter - preparing documentation for an unverified employer is exactly what Dario's 16/09 rule forbids.

Rate (GBP 500-650/day) and European overlap are excellent, and the paid-search plus automation half is strong. Held at 80 because the scope is 0-to-1 GTM leadership with proven SaaS outcomes required, and the case-study source puts B2B SaaS pipeline as the weakest evidenced area. Also the single strictest handling rule in the batch: the posting rejects agency applications, so this is individual-only and nothing Adaxa-branded may be sent, CV header included.

Raised above AI-1's 'B - Conditional / $500k budget evidence' reading on the evidence itself: the posting makes personally managed Google spend of $500k+/month mandatory ($1M preferred), and the verified record is approximately EUR 2.5M/month personally managed and optimized. The gate that eliminates most of the market is cleared by roughly 5x the mandatory bar. DTC across Search, Shopping, PMax and YouTube is the deepest part of the record. Only real caveat is US business-hour overlap from Croatia.

cells.Priority: A - Primary / US hours overlap to agree

ops.why: The condition AI-1 recorded is satisfied, and the evidence is in the verified record rather than pending: the $500k/month mandatory gate is met at roughly 5x. Leaving it as 'B - Conditional' would keep a Tier A role parked behind a condition that has already been answered. The remaining caveat is moved into the priority text so it is not lost.
